tasks.name: Campaign relevance GATE — is this a campaign/political message? (~100)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 1. Direct binary gold for the is-campaign gate — unlocks a free local classifier to replace the ~$300-1,500 Haiku relevance run. Balanced 50/50, boundary-oversampled. Judge from the text.

tasks.name: Sentiment — 3-class, 5-model check (~100)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 2. Anchors RuBERT-tiny2 accuracy + its neutral-over-prediction bias (the standing publication blocker). ~75 model-disagreement rows + ~25 all-agree anchor.

tasks.name: Channel actor-type — confirm/correct (110)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 3. rusclf v3 gold. The username rule mislabels regional NEWS channels as party/ER — your corrections are the ONLY clean news/not_political negatives. Code the negatives deliberately.

tasks.name: Court decision extraction — confirm/correct (120)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 4. First-ever gold for court-decision extraction (verdict/sentence/fine/articles). Feeds a rusclf v3 court slice → then the full 122K corpus runs $0 local.

tasks.name: Blame attribution — BLIND (81)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 5. Does a disaster post attribute responsibility, to whom, how strongly + futility? No Haiku shown (unbiased κ). Unblocks the disaster paper's per-event blame consumption.
